{{Attr|Stun}} |tooltip-1 = A cheap tower that can be quickly upgraded to provide some freezing AOE support. }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|A jolly snowball fighter who prefers to fight in the best way they know how!|Store Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Golden Snowballer''' is an exclusive golden perk first shown off in a [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mLo1Df4GDwM Jordan Stayt stream]. It is a stronger version of the '''Snowballer''', though it is quite clearly a joke tower going off its obscene stats and meme references. The '''Golden Snowballer''' throws yellow snow at enemies, dealing damage to them. These snowballs also freeze enemies. The explosion can only hit a limited number of enemies. These enemies receive damage based on their distance from the center of the explosion. The further away they are, the less damage they receive.
